title.en-US: What the drainage survey found under Elm Street

summary.en-US: The survey was meant to be routine. It was not.

body.en-US:
We expected a clay pipe and a bit of silt. We found a culvert nobody had on record.

## What we did

We camera-surveyed the full run, mapped the connections and re-routed the outfall before the resurfacing crew arrived.

## What we would do differently

Records are a starting point. Walk the line with a camera before you commit to a design.

seoDescription.en-US: A routine drainage survey turned up an unrecorded culvert under Elm Street.
